title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 039
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute location and map variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Map pin outline with a round center ring and a pointed bottom tip
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the simplest location pin without a base or extra frame.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the grounded or framed location pins when the plain pointed drop matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a classic drop pin with one centered ring and pointed bottom tip.

items.depicts_observation: Map pin outline standing above a wide oval ground ring
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a location pin that visibly rests on an oval ground ring.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain pin when the oval base beneath the pin is part of the form.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a wide oval ring under the pin to suggest a ground shadow or base.

items.depicts_observation: Map pin outline sitting inside a low trapezoid base frame
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a location pin paired with a low base frame instead of an oval ring.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain or oval based pins when the trapezoid base is visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces the oval ground ring with a low trapezoid style base frame.

items.depicts_observation: Folded map outline with three vertical panels and two inner fold lines
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple folded map instead of a location pin.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the square map sign when the three folded panels should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the classic folded map shape with three vertical panels.

items.depicts_observation: Square map panel with a diagonal route line meeting a top ridge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a compact square map panel rather than a folded paper map.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the folded map when the square panel and route line are the visible cues.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot compresses the map into one square panel with a route line across it.
